posts.en:
dsh-harmony is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Lets one DSH plugin modify another plugin's code at runtime, with Patch ordering, conflict checks, and hot reload.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-70a19132b0d0f2e18b18.html
